claims: PlayStation Network is recovering from a major, widespread outage as of March 21-22, 2026.
Many PlayStation Network services are back online as of March 21-22, 2026.
Some users still experience issues with games and social features on PlayStation Network as of March 21-22, 2026.
Sony's official status page initially reported issues with "Gaming & Social" services.
Most PlayStation Network services are now reported as functional.
A major, global outage occurred on PlayStation Network.
The PlayStation Network outage caused issues with logging in on PS4 and PS5.
The PlayStation Network outage caused issues with accessing online games on PS4 and PS5.
The PlayStation Network outage caused issues with using social features on PS4 and PS5.
Reports from users indicate the PlayStation Network situation is settling down.
Reports from users indicate most PlayStation Network services are returning to normal.
